'''Sop saudara''' is an [[Indonesian cuisine|Indonesian]] [[beef]] or [[Buffalo meat|buffalo]] [[soup]] specialty from [[Makassar]] city, [[South Sulawesi]].<ref name=tv>{{cite news|author=Usman|title=Wisata Kuliner Makassar: Menikmati Sop Saudara Dan Ikan Bandeng Bakar (optional) Khas Pangkep|url=http://www.makassartv.co.id/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=7389&catid=3&Itemid=56|date=23 March 2012|work=MakassaRTV|access-date=25 July 2013|url-status=usurped|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160305045032/http://makassartv.co.id/index.php?catid=3&id=7389&itemid=56&option=com_content&view=article|archive-date=5 March 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|author=Odilia Winneke|title=Konro Bakar Empuk Racikan Daeng Memang|url=http://food.detik.com/read/2012/05/21/105453/1920579/933/konro-bakar-empuk-racikan-daeng-memang|date=21 May 2012|work=detikFood|access-date=25 July 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Sop Pakai Lombok|url=http://www.hariansumutpos.com/arsip/?p=17247|date=9 November 2009|work=Sumut Pos|access-date=25 July 2013}}</ref> The soup is commonly served with [[steamed rice]] and ''[[ikan bakar|ikan bolu bakar]]'' (grilled [[milkfish]]).<ref name=tv/><ref>{{cite news|title=Menu Tradisional Bugis|url=http://lifestyle.okezone.com/read/2008/11/15/26/164363/|date=15 November 2008|work=Okezone.com|access-date=25 July 2013}}</ref>
